title: Penalty for possessing unlicensed arms, ammunition or military stores
source_citation: Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk) / Official Gazette, West Pakistan Arms Ordinance, 1965
verbatim_text: Whoever acquires, possesses, or carries any firearm or ammunition without a valid license shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to seven years, or with fine, or with both.
